transcript.message: We’re making our opening bid of 39.5M for Leo Silva.
We won’t be making a new offer at this stage.

We’re prepared to consider a higher offer if they’re willing to move closer to our expectations.
We’re not interested in a base salary that doesn’t match Leo’s current standing in the league.
We’re making our final offer of 39.5M plus up to 7.9M in add-ons.
We’re not holding back on our stance, and with Eastgate in the mix, you’ll need to step up.
We’ve received other interest, and we’re not willing to settle for less than what’s fair.

We’re ready to move forward with 46M if that’s the best you can do.
We’re finalising the personal terms with a 5-year contract and a base salary that aligns with Leo’s current market position.
We’re happy to accept the 6.4M a year on a 5-year contract.
